policy_en: Unified total-emissions ranking evidence ledger. Complete rows may enter the comparable ranking only after Scope 1, selected Scope 2 value/method, Scope 3, and finance Scope 3 boundary where applicable pass the strong-evidence gate. Partial rows and gap candidates are review-only and cannot be auto-promoted.
policy_zh: 企业总排放排行证据统一账本。只有 Scope 1、选定 Scope 2 数值/方法和 Scope 3 全部通过强证据门禁的行，才能进入完整可比排行；partial 行和缺口候选均仅供复核，不允许自动提升。
